title: HPV guidance refreshed for Indian adults
summary: Updated catch-up window and single-dose evidence reviewed against the latest Association of Physicians of India (API) and MoHFW position, with cervical-cancer screening emphasis for Indian women.

title: 2026 seasonal influenza strain composition reviewed
summary: Annual review aligned with WHO India influenza surveillance. Reminder: adults need a fresh dose every year because circulating strains change.

title: Meningococcal (MenACWY) travel guidance reviewed
summary: Guidance reviewed for Indian travellers (Hajj/Umrah and sub-Saharan Africa) and high-risk adults, per API recommendations.

title: Rabies post-exposure schedule reviewed
summary: Post-exposure and pre-exposure schedules reviewed against National Rabies Control Programme (MoHFW) guidance for India.
